answer: At an onyx port, agents compete to schedule anchor inspections before ships cross the horizon. Assign jobs by a lottery weighted only by escrowed tokens, with no bonus per account. Validators snapshot the escrow at one block and reject any deposit pledged twice. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand aliases preserves the same total winning probability. To double expected allocation, an attacker must lock twice the capital for the full inspection period, paying its liquidity cost; extra names buy no extra chances.
